svg.title: Delegated agent identity and authorization
svg.desc: A user authenticates to an application. The application creates a non-human agent identity and a short-lived delegated capability constrained by user, tenant, action, resource, purpose, time, and approval. A policy decision point authorizes a tool or agent-to-agent call and writes an audit record.
svg.text: Identity and authorization: user intent is not broad agent power
tenant · scope · resource · purpose · expiry · approval
Use short-lived, audience-bound credentials and resource-side policy checks; never share a user token or give an agent a standing admin secret.
